_comment: PayWall's live subscriber count, by hand (#201).
PayWall has no API known to us, so this comes from the maintainers' export
and is updated by pull request -- which is the same discipline as the goal
in config/support_goal.yml, and for the same reason: a number the site
prints about its own supporters should have a diff and a reviewer.
deploy/oc-stats.sh merges it into support-stats.json each hour, so the
public endpoint carries the total rather than only the Open Collective
half. `as_of` is checked like any other timestamp: once it is older than
PAYWALL_STALE_DAYS the PayWall half is dropped and the site shows the Open
Collective count alone, rather than quietly counting people who may have
Figures below are from the export quoted in #201. They want refreshing.
